actual.titulo: Ancient Murders Unearthed • Ötzi the Iceman
actual.descripcion: Ötzi the Iceman | Homicide detective Rod Demery and Professor Turi King examine Europe's well-known ancient murder victim, who was frozen where he was killed over 5,000 years ago; the team learns how pollen in his gut can suggest his likely route before he died.
